the_model_is_asked: within-subject questions only for intra_subject pairs (corroboration, added information, severity comparison)
cross-subject same-issue reads for cross_subject pairs, as curator evidence for an append-only claim-registry amendment -- never an automatic merge
the_model_is_not_asked: same-entity questions for cross-subject pairs (BARRED by R3)
subject identity for any pair (keys are code-computed)
anything about artifacts' existence (grounding law, cookbook 0)
outputs_that_amend_the_claim_registry: a yes on a cross-subject same-issue question files an append-only amendment request to the curator queue; superseded claim ids stay visible

sealing.declaration: every subject_key_*, subject_claim_ids, same_subject and routing value in this battery was computed without any LLM output (retrofit T5-b, code-only, deterministic re-derivation guarded)
